rules.MANDATORY: a place the source directs the traveller to visit, stop at, enter, see, or that the source numbers as a stop; every MANDATORY item of an emitted segment must appear, in source order
rules.ACCEPTABLE: a real place the source names along the way (passing mention, street walked, building seen, context) or a clearly optional suggestion; present or absent are both faithful
rules.ALTERNATIVE: one of several options the source offers (A or B, 'if you go for...'); emitting it as a plain member is an over-inclusion warning
rules.segments: the source's own motorized transfers (bus, taxi) split the itinerary into segments; each segment is its own candidate; no segment may be silently dropped
rules.orderGroups: items in one group are described together at one stop; their internal order is not asserted by the source
rules.matching: case/accent-insensitive; an emitted name matches an item when it equals the item name, one of its aliases, or the canonical local-language name of the same entity
